content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the NAM Kasaragod Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Clinical Psychologist: M.Sc (Clinical Psychology) or M.A/M.Sc Psychology or equivalent from UGC recognized University/Institute owned by Government of Kerala/National Institutes of Government of India; M.Phil in Clinical Psychology or equivalent 2-year course from RCI approved University/College/Institution; Rehabilitation Council of India Registration as Clinical Psychologist

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NAM Kasaragod Clinical Psychologist Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: NAM Kasaragod Clinical Psychologist Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Ayush Mission, Kasaragod (NAM Kasaragod) in the state of Kerala for filling up various contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this notification?
faq.answer: The post notified under this recruitment advertisement is Clinical Psychologist, aimed at strengthening healthcare delivery services under the Ayush framework in Kasaragod.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Clinical Psychologist position under the current notification released by NAM Kasaragod.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Eligible candidates directly report to the designated venue with necessary credentials on the specified interview date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Clinical Psychologist post is scheduled to be held on 07-10-2026 at the designated reporting venue outlined in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for the Clinical Psychologist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess M.Sc or M.A in Psychology/Clinical Psychology along with an M.Phil in Clinical Psychology and valid registration with the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI).

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Clinical Psychologist position is 40 years. Candidates should verify age limits against official rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates appointed for the Clinical Psychologist position will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 30,000 per month on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories as per the official notification details.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original educational certificates, RCI registration proof, identity cards, experience certificates, and self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents to the interview.
